description: E2d4: an agent's visual audit of the 38 scored Wikisource reference pages (E2d3e pool) against their scans. Each proposal is a suggested correction of the current reference text; it is never attestation and never changes a reference by itself. Only a human decision (reference_audit_decisions.v1) applies a correction.
method_detail: every page read tile by tile on enlarged crops of a 1920 px render of the pinned scan (same file, page and framing as the scored 960 px image), word by word against the reference; unclear spots zoomed 2-4x; OCR disagreements (Tesseract and R3h+blla agreeing on another reading) used only as pointers and each checked on the scan. Conventions not reported: line breaks and paragraphing, running heads and page numbers, [n] footnote marks, glyph identity of quote marks, geresh/gershayim, maqaf and dashes, and the old typographic space before ':' or '.'
text_license: CC BY-SA 4.0 (Hebrew Wikisource); quoted spans keep that licence
